title: Live player count and a new launch screen

cards.title: How many people are playing, right now
cards.body:
The launch popup carries a live player count from Steam, for every game in your library rather than only the Steam ones.

The popup itself is optional: turn it on in *Settings > General > App*.

cards.title: A launch screen worth looking at
cards.body: Starting a game now fills the screen with its artwork, animated, with a line of text picked at random while you wait.

cards.title: Official Steam artwork as a fallback
cards.body:
A game with no community artwork now falls back to the official art from its store page.

The Artwork Picker shows those too, labelled *official*.

cards.title: Idle hiding, on your terms
cards.body: *Hide games on inactivity* used to be on or off. It now takes a delay anywhere between 5 and 15 seconds, or none at all.

cards.title: A quieter Steam
cards.body:
Shift now keeps the Steam client from appearing on top of you when it launches a game or switches accounts.

Steam catalog: a game that has not shipped yet carries a *Coming* badge with its date.

changelog: New: Live Steam player count in the launch popup. The data is taken from the Steam API and applied to all games, including non-Steam ones. You have to enable launch confirmation in Settings > General > App.
New: Revamped launch screen. Now with animated fullscreen artwork and some random text.
New: Official Steam artwork as a fallback. Games with no community artwork now use the official art from their store page. The Artwork Picker page shows it too, labelled *official*.
Adjustable idle delay. "Hide games on inactivity" can now be set anywhere from 5 to 15 seconds, or turned off. It used to be just on or off.
Suppressed Steam's UI in some scenarios. Shift now tries to prevent the Steam client from showing up when launching a game or switching accounts.
Left analog stick and keyboard arrows now do hold/burst navigation, just like the d-pad.
Steam catalog: unreleased games now carry a "Coming" badge with their date.
Several other performance improvements, bug fixes, and UI polish.
